Description
The 37 °C temperature chamber, manufactured by Zwick Roell, is designed with a big front door to easily change the tools. It has dimensions of 405 x 600 x 1250 mm, voltage supply of 230 V, accuracy of ± 1 °C and a maximum ambient temperature of 40 °C. The chamber is ideal for material testing applications.
